fusions.name: Bringing In the Hay
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft round, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Herding Prod
fusions.desc: Prods a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Haystack Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 5 tiles, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Stores
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
